critique: Impeccable execution. The vertical rectangular monolith housing, recessed dial, and chamfered bezel are spot-on. All 9 upper tick marks and 5 beach labels are accurate with a clean bottom arc. The lower sub-dial and single burnt-orange hands on each dial are perfectly rendered. The travertine plinth, warm directional sunlight, and turquoise-to-sand gradient backdrop create an extraordinary, magazine-worthy editorial aesthetic.
